name: Restarting Systems: Smoke's Bizarre Adventure
summary:
6 months ago, Smoke, Chocolate Spread, Paper Clip, Portable Charger, Milk Cap, and Battery were all assembled as a team, each spouting their own unique ability and prowess, by a desperate Red Button, who sought to defeat the corrupted being that had taken her brother, White Button, and hid out on Lucky Island. With a mission in mind, they set off...

In the present day, the aftermath of those events still lingers in the back of Smoke's mind, mainly due to what had happened to Spread, his once closest friend, and Paper Clip-- both struck by an Alteromalie that has robbed them of their memories. Through a series of events, the trio finds themselves in the mystical dimension between dimensions, the Other Realm. With a powerful threat looming on the horizon, Smoke and co set out on a journey and learn the true meaning of comradery and teamwork.
